comment: Written against Qwen Code 0.25.0 (Ink TUI, a Gemini CLI fork, alternate screen) from live sessions recorded in a pty against an OpenAI-compatible LM Studio endpoint; must be re-verified when Qwen Code changes its TUI. The tool confirmation dialog ('Allow execution of: 'curl'?', 'Apply this change?', '› 1. Yes, allow once') with its 'Waiting for user confirmation...' spinner line is BLOCKED; the Braille spinner line ending in '(<n>s · … · esc to cancel)' and the 'Enter to steer · Ctrl+Q to queue' footer shown while a turn runs are WORKING; the '>   Type your message or @path/to/file' input box is IDLE. The input box stays visible while Qwen works, so the idle rule vetoes on 'esc to cancel' and 'Enter to steer' and has the lowest priority; the approval rule anchors its patterns to the start of a line, because a transcript that quotes the dialog text must not read as a pending confirmation. The 'Connect a Provider' onboarding menu intentionally matches no rule. No rule depends on the alternate-screen flag.
